title: My Dear Soldiers
subject: English
summary: “My Dear Soldiers” is a heartfelt poem that expresses love, respect and gratitude towards the brave soldiers of our country. It describes how soldiers protect our nation and keep us safe while facing many dangers and difficulties. They stay away from their families and work in harsh weather conditions to defend our borders. Their courage, dedication and sacrifice make them true heroes of the nation. The poem reminds us to respect and honour the soldiers who serve our country selflessly. It teaches us that we should always be thankful to our soldiers for their bravery, courage and sacrifices.
